newsitem.title: USA: Echo Bay ups stake in Minefinders.
newsitem.headline: Echo Bay ups stake in Minefinders.

text.p: Echo Bay Mines Ltd said it has increased its equity interest in Minefinders Corp Ltd for C$2.3 million.

The increased stake is part of a strategic alliance through which Echo Bay has the right to acquire a 60 percent interest in Minefinders' 100 percent owned Dolores gold exploration property in Chihuahua, Mexico.
Echo Bay said it has acquired an additional 640,000 common shares of Minefinders by exercising 400,000 warrants at C$4.00 per share and 240,000 warrants at C$3.00 per share.
The transaction leaves Echo Bay with 1.92 million common shares of Minefinders, or 20.9 percent of the company's 9.2 million common shares outstanding.
Echo Bay said that Minefinders has agreed that 70 percent of the C$2.3 million generated by the transaction will be used to continue exploration on the Dolores property.
